target_customer: Data engineers and architects at enterprises running data lakes and warehouses
problem: Bad data reaches analytics and AI systems before anyone notices. Telmai monitors data in its raw form in any system, without sampling, to detect and investigate anomalies quickly.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for data observability and data quality
product_category: data observability and data quality platform

founders.name: Mona Rakibe
founders.background_notes: YC page says she started Telmai in November 2020 and spent five years as director of product management at an unnamed data management startup.

founders.name: Maxim Lukichev
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a data science and engineering leader with over 15 years of experience; employers not named.

competitors.name: Monte Carlo
competitors.what: Data observability platform focused on warehouse tables

competitors.name: Bigeye
competitors.what: Data observability and data quality monitoring

technical_complexity.rationale: Anomaly detection over raw data at scale without sampling in data lakes is standard data engineering plus ML, with scaling challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations create some stickiness, but several funded observability vendors offered similar monitoring and the category was crowded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition of Telmai found; peers in the category kept competing.

market_need_then: YC application framed data problems reaching analytics and AI as a pain for data engineers, with demand for lower mean time to detect and resolve.

branding.name_origin: A pun on 'Tell me AI' per the CEO in a Pulse 2.0 profile.

identity.logo: Includes a Greek sigma standing for the math foundations of the approach per the CEO

branding.brand_signature: Sigma in the logo and the 'Tell me AI' pun

brand_strength.rationale: A sourced name pun and logo meaning, but no evidence of community or press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Telmai raised a 2.8 million dollar seed in October 2021 and a 5.5 million dollar seed in June 2023 co-led by Glasswing and .406 Ventures. It remains active and small in a crowded observability category with no Series A found, so traction beyond seed stage is not yet shown.
